items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Bob Carsey and I were talking about maybe doing a duet album at some point.

ctx.x: Are there musicians out there that would be on your wish list to either record with or for you to hire?
Well I just saw Russell Malone downstairs. We were, Bob at Arcadia, Bob Carsey and I were talking about maybe doing a duet album at some point. Not right now but at some © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
point. And I knew I wanted Russell, to do one with Russell. Another one might be Sonny Rollins. I haven’t talked with him yet though. That would be really fun. I would like that.
